sloka: सा तम् उद् वीक्ष्य सुश्रोणी रावणस्य वशम् गता ।समाक्रंदत् भयपरा दुःख उपहतया गिरा ॥३-४९-३७॥
transliteration: sā tam ud vīkṣya suśroṇī rāvaṇasya vaśam gatā ।samākraṁdat bhayaparā duḥkha upahatayā girā ॥3-49-37॥

translations.english: When the griefstricken, largeeyed Sita was lamenting piteously, she saw the vulture (Jatayu) seated on a tree.
